name: Takamatsu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with a white lozenge frame enclosing the character 高 between rays.
history: The flag of Takamatsu bears the city's mon (municipal emblem) in the Japanese civic tradition of a single stylised mark on a plain field.

features.role: Takamatsu municipal emblem — a white lozenge frame enclosing the character 高 between rays
features.symbolism: the character 高 (taka) framed by pine needles
